notes.title: Crows and Pumpkins!
notes.notes:
Eternal Halloween Update:
[list]
[*] Pumpkins and Crows introduced
[*] Night passes 10 times faster (no more long wandering in darkness)
[*] Invader drops 100 minigun ammo instead of 50
[*] Minigun now overheats increasing bullet spread
[*] Rabbits also now wear wigs of rebellion
[*] Lizardman and rabbits were added to Another Canyon map
[*] Randomized weapon materials
[*] More visual effects (better plasma and invader rays, bullet 
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

- performance increase

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Patch notes:
+ Bear cannon now fires three wandering projectiles instead of basic one
+ Save file now properly saved at the end of each of levels (to prevent precious progress loss)
+ Untranslated ending text got translated
